meta.title: COVID-19 Diagnostics, Pathogenesis & Therapeutics Multi-Paper Synthesis (7 Papers)
meta.authors: David A, Hirabayashi E, Dioguardi M, Lan J, Polack FP, Horby P, Shi R, et al.
meta.journal: Multi-Journal Synthesis (J Immunol Methods, JBI Evid Synth, Nature, NEJM)
meta.summary: Unified multi-paper biomedical knowledge model synthesizing 7 seminal COVID-19 research investigations: lateral flow immunoassay accuracy (PMC8259047), rapid antigen testing meta-analysis (PMC11462910), pediatric ACE2 and innate immunity (PMC8293341), Spike-ACE2 structural binding (PMC7158895), BNT162b2 mRNA vaccination (PMC7758245), dexamethasone mortality reduction in the RECOVERY trial (PMC7477535), and therapeutic neutralizing monoclonal antibodies (PMC7330574).

articles.title: Operational characteristics of 30 lateral flow immunoassays used to identify COVID-19 immune response
articles.authors: David A, Scott L, Jugwanth S, et al.
articles.summary: Evaluated 30 lateral flow immunoassays assessing sensitivity, specificity, operational characteristics, and antibody capture kinetics against Spike and Nucleocapsid.

articles.title: Comparison of diagnostic accuracy of rapid antigen tests for COVID-19 compared to the viral genetic test in adults: systematic review & meta-analysis
articles.authors: Hirabayashi E, DeArmond M, Stone AEL, et al.
articles.summary: Meta-analysis of 91 adult studies synthesizing diagnostic accuracy (sensitivity 67.1%, PPV 97.7%) of rapid antigen tests like BinaxNOW and Roche against RT-PCR.

articles.title: Innate Immunity in Children and the Role of ACE2 Expression in SARS-CoV-2 Infection
articles.authors: Dioguardi M, Cazzolla AP, Arena C, et al.
articles.summary: Investigates age-dependent differences showing significantly lower ACE2 nasal epithelial expression in pediatric cohorts correlated with milder clinical presentations.

articles.title: Structure of the SARS-CoV-2 spike receptor-binding domain bound to the ACE2 receptor
articles.authors: Lan J, Ge J, Yu J, Shan S, Zhou H, et al.
articles.summary: Determined the 2.45-angstrom crystal structure of the SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD complexed with human ACE2, revealing key contact residues explaining enhanced transmission.

articles.title: Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine in Phase 3 Trial
articles.authors: Polack FP, Thomas SJ, Kitchin N, et al.
articles.summary: Global trial of lipid nanoparticle-formulated nucleoside-modified mRNA encoding full-length prefusion Spike glycoprotein, demonstrating 95% protection against Covid-19.

articles.title: Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19: Mortality Reduction in the RECOVERY Trial
articles.authors: Horby P, Lim WS, Emberson JR, et al.
articles.summary: Seminal randomized trial proving 6 mg daily dexamethasone reduces 28-day mortality by one-third in ventilated patients and one-fifth in patients requiring oxygen.

articles.title: Human neutralizing antibody cocktail targeting distinct epitopes on SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD
articles.authors: Shi R, Shan C, Duan X, et al.
articles.summary: Isolates human monoclonal antibodies CB6 and CA1 blocking Spike-ACE2 attachment and demonstrating therapeutic viral clearance in animal models.

nodes.name: Spike Glycoprotein (S)
nodes.desc: Trimeric class I viral fusion protein containing S1 receptor binding and S2 fusion subunits.

nodes.name: Receptor-Binding Domain (RBD)
nodes.desc: Critical domain within S1 subunit directly contacting the host ACE2 peptidase domain.

nodes.name: Nucleocapsid Protein (N)
nodes.desc: Highly abundant structural ribonucleoprotein used as capture target in antigen tests.

nodes.name: S1/S2 Furin Cleavage Site
nodes.desc: Polybasic motif (PRRAR) cleaved during viral biogenesis facilitating expanded cell tropism.

nodes.name: RNA-Dependent RNA Polymerase
nodes.desc: Core catalytic replication machinery (NSP12-NSP7-NSP8) targeted by remdesivir.

nodes.name: Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme 2 (ACE2)
nodes.desc: Host functional receptor expressed in alveolar type II cells and nasal epithelium.

nodes.name: TMPRSS2 Serine Protease
nodes.desc: Host cell-surface protease priming Spike at S2' site for pH-independent membrane fusion.

nodes.name: Interleukin-6 (IL-6)
nodes.desc: Key pro-inflammatory cytokine driving systemic cytokine storm and hyperferritinemia in severe ARDS.

nodes.name: ACE2-Mediated Viral Entry
nodes.desc: Sequential binding of RBD to ACE2, cleavage by TMPRSS2, and fusion pore opening.

nodes.name: Hyperinflammatory Cytokine Storm
nodes.desc: Uncontrolled systemic inflammatory response damaging pulmonary capillary endothelia.

nodes.name: Humoral Seroconversion
nodes.desc: Development of high-affinity anti-Spike IgG and neutralizing antibodies following infection or vaccine.

nodes.name: Immunothrombosis & Coagulopathy
nodes.desc: Endothelial activation leading to microvascular in situ thrombosis and D-dimer elevation.

nodes.name: BNT162b2 mRNA Vaccine (Pfizer)
nodes.desc: Lipid nanoparticle mRNA vaccine encoding stabilized prefusion Spike glycoprotein.

nodes.name: Dexamethasone Corticosteroid
nodes.desc: Potent glucocorticoid dampening hyperactive alveolar immune inflammation in oxygen-dependent patients.

nodes.name: Neutralizing Antibody Cocktail (CB6)
nodes.desc: Recombinant monoclonal antibodies sterically blocking Spike RBD from engaging ACE2.

nodes.name: Remdesivir Nucleotide Prodrug
nodes.desc: Adenosine analog causing delayed chain termination of viral RNA synthesis.

nodes.name: Tocilizumab (Anti-IL-6R)
nodes.desc: Monoclonal antibody targeting IL-6 receptor in progressive hyperinflammatory patients.

nodes.name: Real-Time RT-PCR Gold Standard
nodes.desc: Reference molecular diagnostic detecting SARS-CoV-2 genomic RNA targets (N, E, RdRp).

nodes.name: Abbott BinaxNOW Ag Card
nodes.desc: Leading rapid point-of-care lateral flow card detecting viral Nucleocapsid protein in 15 min.

nodes.name: Roche SARS-CoV-2 Rapid Ag
nodes.desc: POC immunochromatographic cassette evaluated in primary care and outpatient settings.

nodes.name: Orient Gene IgG/IgM LFIA
nodes.desc: Lateral flow serology cassette evaluated across pre-pandemic and convalescent blood banks.

nodes.name: Pediatric Nasal Respiratory Epithelium
nodes.desc: Nasal mucosa in children showing lower ACE2 transcript density and constitutive IFN response.

nodes.name: Type II Alveolar Pneumocytes
nodes.desc: Primary distal lung target cells expressing high ACE2 damaged during acute lung injury.

nodes.name: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)
nodes.desc: Severe clinical complication with refractory hypoxemia and bilateral ground-glass opacities.
